title: A handover is a conversation with someone asleep
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Describe the current state — Give the next reader enough context to begin.; Name the requested action — Include authority, timing, and stopping conditions.; Acknowledge the handover — Confirm the next step or missing prerequisite.; Return the result — Update the shared record for the next working day..
